boot.none: This device has not proven its boot. It needs a TPM 2.0, and the agent registers it on its own within a day of starting.
boot.waiting: The TPM is registered, the first proof is on its way
boot.changed: The device started differently than accepted
boot.acceptHint: If you know why, for example a firmware update or a change you made, accept the boot. Otherwise look at the device before you do.
boot.otherTPM: The device came with another TPM. Its proofs do not count until you accept it: that happens when the mainboard was replaced, the TPM cleared, or when the device's files were copied to another computer.
boot.noSecureBoot: Secure Boot is off, so the device cannot prove what started after the firmware. Only changes to the firmware and kernel parameters show.

kinds.quote: A proof did not check out
kinds.revocations: The list of revoked boot loaders changed

errors.invalid_tpm: The TPM data is not valid ({{value}}).
errors.tpm_challenge: The TPM did not answer the challenge.
errors.tpm_unknown: This device has no trusted TPM key yet.
